title: Police investigating bomb threat at BioUrja Renewables, formerly ADM plant, on Edmund Street in Peoria IL, evacuations underway
text:
Police investigating bomb threat at BioUrja Renewables, formerly ADM plant, on Edmund Street in Peoria IL, evacuations underway - ABC7 Chicago 
 24/7 Live Chicago & Suburban Cook Co. North Suburbs West Suburbs South Suburbs NW Indiana Bomb Threat 
 Police investigating bomb threat in Peoria, evacuations underway, officials say 
 By ABC7 Chicago Digital Team Saturday, November 14, 2026 4:34AM 
 Police are investigating a bomb threat at BioUrja Renewables, formerly the ADM plant, on Edmund Street in Peoria, Illinois. Evacuations are underway. PEORIA, Ill. (WLS) -- Police are investigating a bomb threat Friday evening in Peoria, Illinois, officials said.
 The incident happened at BioUrja Renewables, formerly the ADM plant, on Edmund Street.

 Police urged anyone within a mile of the facility to immediately leave their homes or businesses, out of an abundance of caution.
 Governor JB Pritzker says he is monitoring the situation.
 Illinois State Police say they are providing support to Peoria police.
 No further information was available.
